title: The camera moves through a dark futuristic lab filled with glowing red capsules…
content:
The camera moves through a dark futuristic lab filled with glowing red capsules containing human bodies.

[Cut] [Medium close-up, high angle] A bald man lies unconscious inside one of the capsules.

[Cut] [Medium shot, eye level] The man wakes up and rises from the liquid.

[Cut] [Medium shot, slight high angle] He sits up, holds his head, and looks confused.

[Cut] [Close-up, eye level] The man looks shocked.

[Cut] [Medium close-up, eye level] The man looks around the lab in fear.

[Cut] [Wide tracking shot, eye level] The camera moves past rows of capsules containing unconscious people.

[Cut] [Extreme close-up, eye level] The man’s eyes react as he notices a display.

[Cut] [Insert shot, straight-on angle] A digital display counts upward to “+60 YEARS.”

[Cut] [Close-up, eye level] The man stares at the display in shock.

[Cut] [Insert shot, straight-on angle] The display reads, “SUBJECT: SCHO-9. STATUS: ACTIVATED.”

[Cut] [Close-up, slight low angle] The man grabs the tubes connected to his body.

[Cut] [Wide shot, eye level] He climbs out of the open capsule.

[Cut] [Wide shot, central perspective] The man looks down the long corridor filled with capsules.

[Cut] [Medium-wide shot, eye level] He stands beside the capsule and looks around.

[Cut] [Close-up, slight high angle] The man pulls the tubes from his chest.

No music.
